(Corrects fully diluted earnings per share for six months ended June 30, 1997 from 0.56 to 1.56.)

Note 1 -- The weighted average number of common and common equivalent shares outstanding for primary income per share include the dilutive effect of the convertible redeemable preferred stock (all of which had been converted to common stock or redeemed as of March 18, 1997) and Class B warrants and the assumed exercise of stock options. Fully diluted income per share includes the assumed conversion of the convertible subordinated debentures.

Note 2 -- The company capitalizes interest cost into housing inventories nd charges the previously capitalized interest to interest expense when he related inventories are delivered. Interest paid or accrued and interest capitalized was $9.0 million and $17.6 million for the three- and six-month periods ended June 30, 1997 and $8.4 million and $16.3 million for the three- and six-month periods ended June 30, 1996.
